name: Machine Biceps Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot and rest your upper arms on the pad.
Take an underhand grip on the handles and sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Curl the handles smoothly upward toward your shoulders by squeezing your biceps firmly.
Lower the handles slowly back to near full extension without resting the weight stack between repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms pressed steadily against the pad instead of leaning back to pull the handles up.
Avoid letting your wrists curl inward; keep them straight in line with your forearms.
